name: model_installer
summary: Unified HuggingFace + Ollama search, download, install, and register. One CLI, one canonical tree (studio/models/), one source-of-truth registry.json. Every install writes a VM-CONSOLIDATION config JSON + a registry entry.
engine_pattern: subprocess-driven (huggingface-cli + ollama) with Python fallback (huggingface_hub + ollama libs). Each install is content-addressed via the registry's asset_id naming convention.
supported_brands: cloud (anthropic / grok / openai — config-only, no weights)

inbound_callers: CLI: python3 model_installer.py search | install | list | taxonomy | sync-registry

guarantees: Deterministic path: same (brand, category, subtype) → same directory
One registry.json — auto-rebuilt by sync-registry; never hand-edit
Idempotent installs: re-installing a known model updates metadata, doesn't re-download
consumed_by: core/lib/forward_projector.py (posthoc projector picks CC_TINY_MODEL from installed Ollama models)
usage_example: python3 core/lib/model_installer.py install --ollama 'qwen2.5-coder:1.5b' --category text_generation --subtype code\npython3 core/lib/model_installer.py sync-registry
